s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic pruritic skin lesions with hyperkeratotic plaques
salient_findings: Pruritic lesions on the scrotum and buttock
Annular gray hyperkeratotic plaques with atrophic center and elevated edge
Hyperkeratosis, irregular papillomatosis, and parakeratotic columns on histopathology
key_facts: 10-year history of pruritic lesions
Lesions located on scrotum, buttock, groin, and intergluteal cleft
Previous treatment at local clinic with little improvement
No relevant medical history
No family history of similar skin problems
Normal or negative routine blood work, syphilis serologies, and HIV testing
Histopathological examination revealed hyperkeratosis and parakeratotic columns
Perivascular infiltration of lymphocytes in the dermis
No inguinal adenopathy

shortlist.label: Darier disease
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathological examination revealed hyperkeratosis and parakeratotic columns, consistent with Darier disease

shortlist.label: Grover disease
shortlist.why_kept: Pruritic lesions with hyperkeratotic plaques, consistent with Grover disease

shortlist.label: Hailey-Hailey disease
shortlist.why_kept: Family history not mentioned, but histopathological findings could be consistent with Hailey-Hailey disease

shortlist.label: Porokeratosis
shortlist.why_kept: Annular gray hyperkeratotic plaques with atrophic centers, consistent with porokeratosis

shortlist.label: Disseminated superficial porokeratosis
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple scattered lesions with similar characteristics, consistent with disseminated superficial porokeratosis

raw.rationale: The presence of well-defined, annular gray hyperkeratotic plaques with an atrophic center and a slightly elevated edge, along with histopathological findings of hyperkeratosis, parakeratotic columns, and dyskeratotic keratinocytes, are characteristic of porokeratosis.

rejected.label: Darier disease
rejected.why: Darier disease typically presents with greasy, crusted papules in seborrheic areas, which does not match the description of the lesions in this case.

rejected.label: Grover disease
rejected.why: Grover disease is characterized by sudden onset of pruritic papules, which is not consistent with the 10-year history of lesions in this case.

rejected.label: Hailey-Hailey disease
rejected.why: Hailey-Hailey disease typically presents with flaccid blisters and erosions in the intertriginous areas, which is not consistent with the description of the lesions in this case.

rejected.label: Disseminated superficial porokeratosis
rejected.why: While the histopathological findings are similar, the term 'disseminated superficial porokeratosis' is sometimes used to describe a specific subtype of porokeratosis, and the term 'porokeratosis' is more general and encompasses this subtype.

rejected.label: Grover disease
rejected.why: The clinical and histological features do not align with Grover disease
